title: Migraine Aura Lead Time Before Pain
dataSources: Allergy symptoms (`allergy:entry`), migraine records (`migraine:entry`), bathroom visits (`bathroom:visit`), and sleep-talking events (`sleeptalk:event`).
app: Symptom telemetry for allergy diaries, migraine aura tracking, bathroom frequency logging, and sleep-talking review sent to Splunk HEC via apps and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=migraine:entry
| search aura_lead_min=*
| stats avg(aura_lead_min) as avg_aura_lead_min perc90(aura_lead_min) as p90_aura_lead_min count as samples by trigger_type
| sort 0 - avg_aura_lead_min
description: Measures migraine aura lead time by trigger type.
value: Lead time after aura is one of the most useful practical windows for deciding whether to medicate or change plans.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for migraine aura lead time to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 migraine aura lead time.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how long migraine aura lead time usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
